messages:
Maria: FYI MerchantCo legal just asked for SOC 2 Type II report + signed pen-test letter before we can start the POC. They want a delivery timeline and confirmation whether Dedicated/private deployment is required.

Arjun: @Maria thanks — do they want our ISO artifact bundle too? I can pull a pared-down assurance pack. What deadline are they giving?

Priya: Hi Maria/Arjun — sorry for the late ping. Our security team needs the docs by COB next Tue. POC kickoff target: Mon 2026-04-06. We prefer hosted but may require VPC if data residency is flagged.

Leo: We can share the SOC2 report (redacted) + a signed pen-test attestation. ISO artifacts (scope doc, SoA) are available but need review before sharing. I can get the pen-test letter signed by Wednesday. :white_check_mark: 

Sam: Note on deployment options: if they want VPC/private, onboarding lead time is ~2-3 weeks for network config and IP allowlist; hosted POC can be same-day. Tradeoff is the pricing delta — @Maria we should call out the Dedicated vs hosted cost difference in the quote.

Arjun: Quick checklist I sent to MerchantCo: 
```
- SOC2 (redacted)
- Signed pen-test letter
- ISO scope + SoA
- Data flow diagram
- KMS/HSM attestation (if required)
- SSO/SCIM setup instructions
```
@Priya can you confirm which of these you actually need for sign-off?

Priya: Confirmed: everything except the KMS/HSM attestation for now. Also need a short note on model isolation for the POC (one paragraph is fine).

Leo: Model isolation note: hosted instances are multi-tenant at the infra level but requests and customer data are logically isolated; Dedicated/Private provides tenant-level physical isolation and dedicated HW. I'll draft a 1-paragraph statement and attach it to the pack.

assurance-bot: Uploaded: https://redwood.example.com/assurance/merchantco/ — SOC2_redacted.pdf, PenTest_Attestation_signed.pdf (uploaded by Leo) :white_check_mark: 

Maria: Pricing note for the sales deck: hosted POC estimated at ~$600/day for expected token usage; Dedicated minimum monthly commits add a fixed monthly fee + per-token. @Sam can you add a short summary we can share with procurement?

Sam: Added a short pricing blurb to the shared doc: https://docs.redwood.com/sales/merchantco-pricing — highlights include commit tiers, provisioning lead times, and estimated uplift for VPC/Dedicated.

Arjun: Next steps: 1) Leo to drop the signed pen-test letter + model isolation blurb (by Wed), 2) Sam to confirm Dedicated lead times & pricing blurb, 3) MerchantCo to confirm whether VPC is required. If they confirm hosted we're green for Mon 2026-04-06 POC. @Priya please confirm.

Priya: I'll confirm VPC vs hosted by EOD tomorrow. Thanks everyone. :pray:
